title: Coherence of canonical iterated comparisons under refinement
statement: Let X,Y,Yprime,Z be schemes [def-pc-scheme], U an open cover of X, q:Y->X, qprime:Yprime->X, p:Z->Y, pprime:Z->Yprime and t:Z->X with p followed by q=t and pprime followed by qprime=t. Let N_a be modules on the charts U_a, M a module on Z, and e_a:t-chart-pullback of N_a ~= restriction of M to the t-pulled chart [def-pc-base-change]. Let rho_a map the qprime chart to the q chart, commuting with their projections to U_a. Let delta_a map the later iterated limit chart (U pulled by qprime and then pprime) to the earlier one (U pulled by q and then p), commuting both with the projections to Z and with the iterated chart projection followed by rho_a. Then overlapIteratedComparison(U,qprime,pprime,t,hprime,N,M,e) [def-pc-overlap-pair-canonical-comparisons] equals the pullback of the earlier comparison conjugated by the inverse of c_a=pullbackCompOfEq(rho_a, q-chart projection, qprime-chart projection), the comparisons for the two factorizations of delta_a followed by the earlier iterated chart projection, and the comparison for delta_a followed by the earlier Z projection. The five factors are exactly those in the Lean statement. This is an equality of isomorphism families; it assumes no pair map or pair square, no stage-base refinement arrow r, no finite presentation and no nonemptiness.

proof.text: For arbitrary chart arrows and a pseudofunctor F, use mapComp prime pentagon twice on the n,rho,vprime and n,v,delta triangles to combine the source comparisons. A third use for k,d,delta combines the map to the direct chart. Naturality moves the pullback of e across mapComp(d,delta), and the inverse pentagon for l,d,delta cancels the remaining target comparisons. This proves the generic equality of homs; Iso.ext gives the equality of isomorphisms. These calculations are explicit in the private helpers, with no sorry.

proof.text: Specialize to modulesPseudofunctor and convert mapComp prime to pullbackCompOfEq using modulesPseudofunctor_mapComp_prime_hom_app_eq. This yields the normalized scheme-arrow coherence identity. The six factors of overlapIteratedComparison equal its four-factor normalized expression, by trans_symm, equality-of-arrow comparison symmetry, and associativity.

proof.text: The composite delta_d followed by the earlier direct-chart map equals the later direct-chart map. Compare both projections of the universal direct pullback: the Z projection agrees by hdeltaf, and the original-chart projection agrees by hdeltav and hrho. Instantiate the normalized scheme-arrow identity with these maps and their projection equations. This gives the stated equality of canonical comparison families, pointwise and then by funext.

lean.statement:
theorem overlap_iterated_comparison_refinement
    {X Y Y' Z : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.OpenCover.{u})
    (q : Y ⟶ X) (q' : Y' ⟶ X)
    (p : Z ⟶ Y) (p' : Z ⟶ Y') (t : Z ⟶ X)
    (h : p ≫ q = t) (h' : p' ≫ q' = t)
    (N : (a : U.I₀) → (U.X a).Modules) (M : Z.Modules)
    (e : ∀ a, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom t a)).obj (N a) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U.pullback₁ t).f a)).obj M)
    (ρ : ∀ d, (U.pullback₁ q').X d ⟶ (U.pullback₁ q).X d)
    (hρ : ∀ d, ρ d ≫ U.pullbackHom q d = U.pullbackHom q' d)
    (δ : ∀ d, ((U.pullback₁ q').pullback₁ p').X d ⟶
      ((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p).X d)
    (hδf : ∀ d, δ d ≫ ((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p).f d =
      ((U.pullback₁ q').pullback₁ p').f d)
    (hδv : ∀ d, δ d ≫ Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U.pullback₁ q) p d =
      Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U.pullback₁ q') p' d ≫ ρ d) :
    overlapIteratedComparison U q' p' t h' N M e =
    let V := U.pullback₁ q
    let V' := U.pullback₁ q'
    let A := fun d ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q d)).obj (N d)
    let c := fun d ↦ pullbackCompOfEq (ρ d) (U.pullbackHom q d)
      (U.pullbackHom q' d) (hρ d) (N d)
    let ε := overlapIteratedComparison U q p t h N M e
    (fun d ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom V' p' d)).mapIso
        (c d).symm ≪≫
      pullbackCompOfEq (Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom V' p' d) (ρ d)
        (δ d ≫ Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom V p d) (hδv d).symm (A d) ≪≫
      (pullbackCompOfEq (δ d) (Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom V p d)
        (δ d ≫ Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom V p d) rfl (A d)).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (δ d)).mapIso (ε d) ≪≫
      pullbackCompOfEq (δ d) ((V.pullback₁ p).f d)
        ((V'.pullback₁ p').f d) (hδf d) M)
